name: Autumn Weed
description: An organic, plant-like structure that utilizes stochastic rules to generate natural-looking, asymmetrical branching. It randomly assigns different shades of autumn colors (reds and golds) to its extremities to simulate falling foliage.

name: Crystal Tree
description: A tree-like fractal that grows crystalline structures along its branches.

name: Weeping Willow
description: A highly irregular, dense plant structure simulating a weeping willow.

name: Advanced Baobab
description: As recursion deepens, branches become shorter but thicker, simulating the stout, bulky growth of a Baobab tree.

name: Neon Hilbert Maze
description: A mesmerizing, continuous space-filling fractal that folds infinitely into itself to form a dense, perfectly square labyrinth.

name: Spring Blossom
description: A tall, organic stalk that generates asymmetrical, randomized growth.
